name: griddatan
expr: vlin = griddatan(X2, v, [0.5 0.5]); vnear2 = griddatan(X2, v, [0.4 0.4], 'nearest'); vnear3 = griddatan(X3, v3, [0.1 0.1 0.1], 'nearest');
comment: Sig: vi = griddatan(X, v, xi [, method]) — N-D scattered-data interpolation. X is m×n data points, v is m×1 values, xi is k×n queries. v1 supports 'nearest' for any n (brute-force Euclidean NN) and 'linear' for n=2 only (delegates to 2-D barycentric/Delaunay, same as griddata). KNOWN GAP: 'linear' for n≥3 needs a real N-D Delaunay (Qhull-style); not in v1 — errors with a clear pointer message. Default method = 'linear' (MATLAB-compat). Bit-exact MATLAB R2025b on the supported method+dim combinations.
